purpose: One canonical data pipeline for reproducible Jubilee research, prospective forecasts and leakage-safe validation.

layers.rule: Discovery URLs do not count as raw ingestion.
Observation, model guidance, proxy, human report and historical literature evidence remain explicit source classes.
Reposts and news stories deriving from the same original post share one independence group. Hypoxia without shoreline migration is not automatically a Jubilee label.
Post-event information cannot enter pre-event forecast features.
No report is weak evidence and never a clean negative by itself.
A model is not production-calibrated without held-out event/season evaluation.
Forecast record and exact input snapshot must exist before event verification for prospective skill measurement.

time_semantics.observed_at: when the physical or human observation occurred
time_semantics.available_at: earliest time the forecasting system could legitimately know the value
time_semantics.issued_at: when a forecast was frozen and published to the forecast ledger

efficiency_rules: Cache authoritative downloads by content hash and request parameters.
Do not redownload immutable historical files when hash/version is unchanged.
Run source-specific normalization once, then reuse normalized observations across research and forecasts.
Keep expensive image vision behind freshness/frozen-frame/visibility checks.
Use one canonical feature generator for backtests and production to prevent training-serving skew.
Persist rejected feature decisions so research does not repeatedly rediscover weak ideas.
